summary.text: The bill would require the Department of Justice to establish national standards for preventing, reducing, and punishing sexual harassment and sexual assault committed by incarcerated individuals against Bureau of Prisons staff. It would also mandate that the Bureau of Prisons implement recommendations from a Justice Department Inspector General report on addressing such incidents.
